arguments.content:
import pandas as pd

path = "budget.xlsx"

# Show all sheet names
xl = pd.ExcelFile(path)
print("Sheets:", xl.sheet_names)

for sheet in xl.sheet_names:
    df = pd.read_excel(path, sheet_name=sheet, header=None)
    print(f"\n--- Sheet: {sheet} (shape={df.shape}) ---")
    print(df.to_string())

from openpyxl import load_workbook

# Values view for amounts
wbv = load_workbook('budget.xlsx', data_only=True)
ws = wbv['Budget']

amounts = []
for r in range(11, 23):
    cat = ws.cell(row=r, column=1).value
    item = ws.cell(row=r, column=2).value
    amt = ws.cell(row=r, column=3).value
    amounts.append(amt)
    print(f"Row {r}: {cat!r} | {item!r} | {amt!r}")

numeric = [a for a in amounts if isinstance(a, (int, float))]
total = sum(numeric)
print(f"TOTAL_EXPENSES={total}")
print(f"CELL_C23_VALUE={ws.cell(row=23, column=3).value!r}")

# Formula view to check whether C23 already holds a SUM formula
wbf = load_workbook('budget.xlsx', data_only=False)
wsf = wbf['Budget']
print(f"CELL_C23_FORMULA={wsf.cell(row=23, column=3).value!r}")
